messages:
Maya: Hey team, traveling to SF next Monday with my mom who needs gluten-free meals. We'll be around Market & 5th. Any calm, kid-friendly dinner spots that handle GF?
Josh: @Maya Rocco's Pizzeria will do GF crust if you call. Kids like it. :pizza:
Priya: Blue Bird Kitchen has GF pasta and a nice patio. Staff's used to allergy notes.
Liam: Leaf & Loaf on 6th is quieter, good early seating, they have a GF saffron risotto.
Emily: +1 Leaf & Loaf. They can bring a high chair. Order the roasted veg side.
Tom: Market Dumplings is casual; steamed rice & GF-friendly sauces, quick turnaround.
Maya: Thanks! Also, any breakfast places open by 6:30am for an early flight?
Rachel: Sunrise Grind opens at 6am. Good coffee and GF granola bowls, 4-min walk.
Josh: Bagel Barn (Embarcadero) will do a GF bagel on request until 9am if you need handheld.
Priya: Quick poll: kid-friendly/relaxed (Leaf & Loaf / Blue Bird / Market Dumplings) or slightly fancier?
Maya: Kid-friendly please.
Emily: Vote: Leaf & Loaf :thumbsup:
Liam: Fancy vote: :tophat: (I'll keep it in my pocket)
Tom: I can call Leaf & Loaf and request a corner table + high chair.
Maya: That would be amazing, thank you.
Tom: Called and held Mon 6:30pm for 3 under "Maya". Conf #L8F-331. They confirmed GF options.
Maya: You're the best, thank you all! :heart:
Rachel: If you want after-dinner sweets, Sweet Harbor two blocks over has a GF almond cake.
Maya: Adding that. Appreciate the recs! :tada:
